# SISMN LLC - Comprehensive Technical & Corporate Knowledge Base

## Executive Overview
SISMN LLC is an integrated real estate acquisition, architectural design, civil & structural engineering, and construction management firm based in Dallas, Texas. Founded over 25 years ago by Imran Pirzada, the firm bridges the gap between technical municipal engineering, board-certified architecture, and real estate investment delivery.

The firm operates under statutory authorization from the State of Texas:
- Texas Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors (TBPELS): Firm Registration #F-10492
- Texas Board of Architectural Examiners (TBAE): Architectural Firm Registration #BR-4902

Corporate Headquarters:
SISMN LLC
13151 Emily Rd. #100, Dallas, TX 75240
Phone: (214) 453-9999 / (214) 715-1010

Website: https://sismnllc.com

## Detailed Service Disciplines

### 1. Architectural & Engineering (A&E) Services
- Conceptual design packages, 3D BIM Level-3 architectural renderings, and photorealistic CAD modeling.
- Stamped and sealed structural calculations for commercial retail centers, healthcare facilities, multi-story hospitality hotels, and residential subdivisions.
- Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) load distributions, HVAC ductwork design, electrical single-line diagrams, and clinical medical gas layouts.
- Civil site engineering including grading, paving, stormwater detention basins, drainage calculations, sanitary sewer collection, and TXDOT roadway access permitting.
- Texas Accessibility Standards (TAS) review and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliance audits.

### 2. Real Estate Acquisition & Advisory
- Comprehensive site evaluation, environmental Phase I/II assessment coordination, and geotechnical soil exploration.
- Municipal land entitlement, zoning variances, comprehensive plan amendments, and city council hearing representation.
- Preliminary platting, replatting, and final construction document recording with municipal and county authorities across Texas.
- Financial pro forma modeling, land valuation, highest-and-best-use (HBU) studies, and return-on-equity projections.

### 3. Construction & Project Management
- Complete turnkey general contracting and construction administration.
- Owner's representative advisory, bidding contractor evaluations, schedule-of-values auditing, and lien waiver verification.
- Continuous onsite quality assurance / quality control (QA/QC), geotechnical compaction verification, and concrete break testing coordination.
- Accelerated fast-track municipal permitting and final Certificate of Occupancy (CO) procurement.

### 4. Capital Placement & Joint Ventures
- Structured co-investment opportunities in master-planned single-family communities and commercial shopping centers.
- Direct equity partnerships and syndication structuring with conservative debt-to-equity ratios.
- Transparent reporting and audited accounting practices under Texas corporate law.

## Historical Track Record (Sample of Delivered Projects)
- Saigon Courtyard Shopping Center (Arlington, TX) - 25+ retail suites, dining grease trap infrastructure.
- Las Colinas MRI Medical Center (Irving, TX) - Specialized RF shielding, high-capacity electrical distribution.
- Manny's Shiloh Plaza (Garland, TX) - Commercial retail and service center.
- Best Western & La Quinta Inn & Suites (Frisco, TX) - Multi-story hospitality developments.
- The Shops at Airport Center (Irving, TX) - Major commercial retail shopping plaza.
- Bardin Crossing Shopping Center (Arlington, TX) - Commercial strip center and pad site development.
- Starbucks Plaza (Grand Prairie, TX) - High-traffic drive-thru retail center.
- Benbrook Middle School (Benbrook, TX) - Educational public works facility.
- Gandhi Memorial Statue Plaza (Irving, TX) - Civic and cultural landmark.
- Masjid Al Noor Community Center (Flower Mound, TX) - Multipurpose civic and assembly structure.
